How to Navigate Dates

  • Swipe left to move to the previous day
  • Swipe right to move to the next day
  • Swipe up to move to the next month, but the same day of the month
  • Swipe down to move to the previous month, but the same day of the month

You can also 'click' on the secular date to see a date selection dialog box.

Zmanim is unable to determine your location because no location sources have been enabled.

Clicking the "Enable" button below will open the "Security & Location" screen, where you can turn on either "Use wireless networks" or "Enable GPS satellites".

Generally, your location can be determined just by enabling the wireless network location source, though sometimes it may be necessary to enable GPS.
